# Check runs that must have concluded `success` on the exact commit a release tag points at (REVIEW R06).
# One GitHub Actions job name per line, exactly as the job's `name:` renders. release.yml fails closed when any of
# them is missing, still running, skipped, cancelled or failed. Keep this list in step with the workflows: a renamed
# job must be renamed here too, or every release tag fails (which is the safe direction).
#
# pr.yml (runs on every push to main)
Static analysis (spotless, detekt, lint, konsist)
Unit + Robolectric tests, coverage gate
Screenshot verification (Roborazzi)
License gate
Dataset validation
Assemble (debug + release)
Workflow lint
# instrumented.yml (runs on every push to main)
API 26
API 30
API 33
API 36
Wear OS 34
# release-dry-run.yml (dispatch it on the commit before tagging)
Unsigned release build, SBOM, changelog preview, reproducibility
# benchmark.yml (dispatch it on the commit before tagging)
# Two checks, because "the job ran" and "the run measured something" are different facts. The gate exits 0 on an
# inconclusive comparison so a runner that cannot measure does not block a release, which made the first of these
# conclude success on commits nothing had measured — v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.1.1 all qualified that way. The second
# fails unless the run measured the commit or benchmark/UNBENCHMARKED.md names it.
Macrobenchmark (nightly)
Performance qualified
